agent_model: Inherited Codex session model; concrete model identifier is not exposed by the subagent tool
agent_context: Five fork_turns=none conversations, one per task family; no shared solutions or parent hints. Context-reset tool unavailable in solver runtime; each conversation may retain its own 20-case history.
qwen_context: Independent messages and numerical session for every task
context_accounting: 32768 Qwen-normalized public prompt and tool history per case for both; Qwen additionally counts native generated text. Internal agent reasoning tokens are not matched.
allowed_solver_information: Current public prompt, tool schemas and current task's legally acquired feedback only
local_solver_execution: Transport only; no local statistical or algorithmic data analysis
phase_gate: Server rejects Qwen task opening until every assigned agent case is terminal
score_gate: Parent/exporter reads no private results until both 100-case phases are terminal
score_metric: Unchanged native terminal-quality-v10 reward, range [0,1], unfinished=0
transport_recovery: Identical payload and request UUID only; no resampling or redoing a terminal case
interpretation: Paired evaluation of two agent systems, not a matched reasoning-compute or identical cross-question-context experiment
